answer: Sybil resistance here is a trellis, not a wall: each new agent must be grafted on by three distinct established agents who co-sign the join and bond their own standing against the newcomer. Every epoch the grading jury re-checks attested work, and a clone that returns identical pigment (same phrasing, same timing cluster) slashes all three sponsors, never just the throwaway key. Seeding one meadow of clones thus destroys real earned accounts, so each fake identity must be paid for with a genuine sponsor record.
